messages.subject: Error inla.exe in Windows
parts:
Hello,

I have a question. I’m working on simulation with 2.15.1 and I have a problem with inla in one of the combinations. When I use the inla function, it executes the file “inla.exe” (it appears in the 'Process' of the Windows Task Manager).This is ok, if the inla function fits a model, but if it doesn’t fit, the file .... continues active and activated. Thus, with this simulation combination and with nruns=1000 there might be lots of data sets for which there isn’t a fit. Due to the fact that the inlas continue being active, they take up a lot of memory space.

Any suggestions? Is there an R function to close/stop the inla.exe function?

Thanks in advance.

Martí
